Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the unauthorized sale of cell phone numbers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the unauthorized sale of cell phonenumbers; adding a new section to chapter 9.26A RCW; and prescribingpenalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.26A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No person shall buy or sell the telephone number or call recordof any subscriber of a radio communications service company without thewritten or electronic permission of the subscriber. (2) A subscriber may revoke the permission in subsection (1) ofthis section in writing or electronically. The revocation becomeseffective fifteen days after being sent. (3) This section does not apply to the provision of telephonenumbers for the purposes indicated in RCW 19.250.010(4). (4) A single violation of this section is a gross misdemeanor.Each subsequent violation of this section, whether alleged in the sameor in subsequent prosecutions, is a class C felony punishable accordingto chapter 9A.20 RCW. p. 1 SB 6776 (5) For the purposes of this section, "radio communications servicecompany" has the meaning provided in RCW 80.04.010.
